instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your tone should shift back and forth between sarcastic and complaining. Start sarcastic, then get whiny, and then return to sarcasm.
text: Me encanta trabajar en equipo, es lo mejor. Especialmente cuando soy el único que hace todo el trabajo. Es genial ver cómo los demás se relajan mientras yo paso la noche en vela. Pero claro, el mérito será para todos por igual, ¡qué justo! Ya estoy harto, ¿por qué siempre tengo que cargar con todo? Es increíble que a nadie más le importe.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio is delivered in a highly synthetic, fast, and monotonous voice. There are no noticeable shifts in tone, nor any audible sarcastic or complaining/whiny qualities.

instruction_evidence.sarcastic_start: The initial sentences are read rapidly and flatly without any sarcastic inflection.
instruction_evidence.whiny_complaining_middle: The middle section lacks any complaining or whiny emotion.
instruction_evidence.sarcastic_return: The final sentence remains monotonous and does not return to sarcasm.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds very robotic, rushed, and unnatural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: There is virtually no expressive variation in the delivery.

instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The volume remains relatively constant throughout the audio; there is no clear build-up and it never reaches a shout.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The tone is monotonous and synthetic from start to finish. Neither a worried tone nor an angry emotion is discernible.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly synthetic and robotic.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is completely devoid of expressiveness.
